Store NMF results in a Seurat object

Source: R/store_nmf_results.R
store_nmf_results.Rd

Takes the list returned by compute_nmf and writes the fit into the Seurat object as a DimReduc slot named obj[["<reduction_prefix><reduction_suffix>"]]. Feature loadings are stored in the reduction's @feature.loadings; fit metadata (Fit_Error, Fit_Summary, Factor_Gene_List) is stored in the reduction's @misc.

store_nmf_results(
  obj,
  nmf_result,
  reduction_suffix = NULL,
  reduction_prefix = "nmf",
  reduction_key_prefix = "NMF"
)

Arguments

obj

A Seurat v5 object.

nmf_result

List as returned by compute_nmf.

reduction_suffix

Character. Appended to reduction_prefix to form the full reduction name, e.g. "Keratinocytes" → "nmf_Keratinocytes". Default NULL.

reduction_prefix

Character. Prefix for the reduction name. Default "nmf".

reduction_key_prefix

Character. Key prefix passed to Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(). The suffix (with non-alphanumeric characters removed) is appended to keep keys unique across groups, e.g. "NMFKeratinocytes_". Default "NMF".

Value

The Seurat object with one new DimReduc added.

Details

For multi-group workflows, call this function once per group in an external loop, passing a distinct reduction_suffix each time (e.g. the cell type name), so each group gets its own DimReduc.

Cells in obj not present in the NMF result receive NA embeddings — this guards against partial or mismatched inputs.

If NMF_Matrix is NULL (e.g. the group was skipped for having too few cells), a message is emitted and no DimReduc is created.

See also

compute_nmf, get_nmf_results
